input_text: Once upon a time there was a small, special bird called a laser. He lived all alone in the blue sky and wanted to have a friend to share it all with.
Once upon a time there was a stubborn little tank.
target_text: She said she wanted a faster tank. She was so stubborn. The little tank felt very sad.

input_text: Once there was a girl named Liz. She wanted to go to the playground, but her mom wanted her to go on the subway. Liz was scared because she had never been on the subway before. When they got to the station, the subway car was a deep purple color.
target_text: The other passengers looked at Liz sympathetically.

input_text: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Shannon. She was three years old and was always curious about the world. She was visiting her uncle and aunt's house.
target_text: Suddenly, an announcement came over the loudspeaker: "All passengers, please put your bag on the train before boarding."

input_text: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. She loved to store her toys in a special space in her room. One day, she became anxious because she could not find her favorite toy, a small blue car.
target_text: Can you help me?" Her mom said, "Of course, Amy. Let's look together."

input_text: Once upon a time there was a little boy. He was walking in the woods near his home when he heard a loud noise. He stopped to listen and heard a meow. He followed the sound and found a kitty stuck up in a tree. The little boy wanted to help. He saw a fisherman nearby so he shouted for him to come help.
target_text: He quickly made a bossy plan to get it down. With the fisherman's help, the kitty was soon free from the tree.

input_text: Once upon a time, there was a cute little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her dolls and her toys. One day, her mommy asked her to help move some furniture around in the living room. Lily was happy to help and started to push the sofa.
target_text: After they finished moving the furniture, Lily's mommy went to the kitchen to make some tea. While she was gone, Lily climbed up on the sofa to play with her dolls. Suddenly, the sofa tipped over and fell on top of Lily. She was hurt very badly and had to go to the hospital.

input_text: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to go to the market with her mommy. They always bought fruits and vegetables. One day, Lily saw a black cat at the market. She thought the cat was cute and wanted to pet it. But her mommy said no because the cat might scratch her.
target_text: The cat scratched her and she cried. Her mommy took her to the hospital but the wound got infected. Lily got very sick and had to stay in the hospital for a long time. She realized that she should have listened to her mommy and not think that she knew better.
